verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs say it tracks incremental replication state, so later runs with the same state ID resume where the previous run left off. This covers the checkpoint/resume half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents automatic retries for transient failures, and nothing shows that state checkpointed mid-sync survives an interrupted run. Missing for 10: automatic retry/backoff for transient failures, explicit mid-sync checkpointing on interruption, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, transient failures retry automatically and interrupted syncs resume from checkpoints instead of restarting

citations.quote: keeps track of the incremental replication state, so that subsequent pipeline runs with the same state ID will always pick up right where the previous run left off
keeps track of the incremental replication state
